evidence.senderRole: an externally owned account selling the token into the pool
evidence.recipientRole: the pool receiving the taxed transfer
evidence.poolRole: the ARCADE/USDC pool on factory 0x942Bd5BFdc5317C5507e326f8EB4BB6058AB5C10, taxed in both directions
evidence.requestedAmountDerivation: the transfer is internal to a swap, so amount is reconstructed as transferToRecipient + transferToTaxDestination; the exact floor identity below confirms the reconstruction.
evidence.computation: One transfer of 716234375328842709468561 emits two Transfer events with the SAME sender: 687585000315689001089819 to 0x183fff18ccbdda0b5aa1c9d9ddeef00d3803b8c0 and 28649375013153708378742 to 0xcb92a075db3d4e965f37936da2100902344650e3 (the token contract itself). fee = floor(amount * 400 / 10000); transferToRecipient = amount - fee reproduces BOTH emitted amounts EXACTLY, so the measured tax is 400 bps with no rounding residue.
evidence.corroboration: 6 of 7 two-leg transfers found while replaying eth_getLogs reproduce the 400 bps floor identity on the into-pool leg; the out-of-pool leg measures 100 bps by debug_traceCall at head against the same pool, so the token is taxed asymmetrically in both directions.
evidence.reproduce: eth_getLogs on address 0xcb92a075db3d4e965f37936da2100902344650e3 over any recent Arc range for topic0 0xddf252ad1be2c89b69c2b068fc378daa952ba7f163c4a11628f55a4df523b3ef, then group by (transactionHash, topics[1]) and look for the two legs sharing a sender where one recipient is the token contract itself. rpc.vf.at/5042 serves eth_getLogs; the dRPC endpoint in ARC_RPC is required for debug_traceCall.

note: Fee-on-transfer token, taxed in BOTH directions at DIFFERENT rates: 400 bps on transfers INTO its USDC pool 0x183fff18ccbdda0b5aa1c9d9ddeef00d3803b8c0 (the cited transaction) and 100 bps on transfers OUT of it, measured against the same pool at head. feeBps carries the higher, conservative 400. A taxed transfer emits TWO Transfer events with the same sender -- the recipient's share and a cut credited to the token contract itself -- so the split is reproducible from eth_getLogs alone. That pool is a constant-product pair on factory 0x942Bd5BFdc5317C5507e326f8EB4BB6058AB5C10; it exposes neither fee() nor tickSpacing(), so it is not a concentrated-liquidity pool and per-pool rate data keyed on a concentrated-liquidity venue cannot describe it. Listing the token is therefore the only way to express its behaviour here. Failure modes by position in a swap path: (1) as INPUT or INTERMEDIATE, the destination pair is credited less than was sent, so a constant-product swap reverts its invariant check; (2) as TERMINAL OUTPUT, the recipient receives less than the quoted amount, breaking the quoted minimum. Found by sweeping recent blocks for the two-leg Transfer signature; the venue was identified afterwards from the transfer's recipient.
